newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary stocks mixed, BUX index closes higher.
newsitem.headline: Hungary stocks mixed, BUX index closes higher.

text.p: Hungarian shares finished a directionless session on the Budapest Stock Exchange, with the BUX index closing higher helped by the gains of Hungarian shares traded on London's SEAQ, dealers said on Monday.
The BUX finished at 3,571.80 points, up 24.43.
"I think it followed the London trends," said Gabor Borda of Concorde Securities.
The oil company MOL, the commercial bank OTP and the chemicals maker TVK rose in London, and they also firmed in Budapest, except for MOL, which remained steady at 1,480 forints.
OTP closed at 2,495 forints, up 65. TVK rose by 5 forints to 1,345.
The drug maker Egis closed at 11,100, up 150 forints, while its competitor Richter dropped 135 to 8,060.

Dealers said Richter's price went down as several market players expected that sellers will pour a package of Richter shares, recently converted from preference shares, on the market in the next few days.

BUX index futures dropped 4.50 to 8.00 points for December, March and June, and rose 35.00 to 79.00 for September and December of 1997 and June of 1998. December 1996 BUX futures closed at 3,710.50 points, the December 1997 maturity finished at 4,435.00 points.
Traders did not see major changes in Hungarian share prices before the third quarter corporate results will be published.
